article.title: Canva推出Brush設計編輯模型，先供Pro訂戶使用
article.title_en: Canva introduces Brush for supported design edits on Pro plans
article.summary: Canva介紹由Canva Research開發的Brush視覺語言模型，先為Canva Pro訂戶提供支援的設計編輯；更廣泛開放仍在後續安排。
article.summary_en: Canva introduced Brush, a vision-language model from Canva Research, for supported design edits by Canva Pro subscribers. Wider availability is planned.
article.why: 創意團隊可評估批量改版及多尺寸延伸，品牌一致性仍需用已批准素材逐頁覆核。
article.why_en: Creative teams can assess bulk revisions and format adaptation, with page-level checks against approved brand assets.
article.next_step: 用一份已批准的多頁簡報試改標題及尺寸，檢查中文字、Logo、色彩與未要求修改的元素。
article.next_step_en: Try a title and format change on an approved deck; inspect Chinese text, logos, colors and elements that should stay unchanged.
highlights: 用戶可在Canva AI選擇Brush，要求跨頁改字或把設計改成另一種渠道格式。
Canva表示輸出元素仍可手動編輯；Brand Kit支援、參考附件及大量圖片版面改善仍在開發。
highlights_en: Users can select Brush in Canva AI for changes across pages or adaptation to another channel format.
Canva says elements remain editable; Brand Kit support, attachment references and image-heavy layout improvements are still in development.
article.detail:
Canva介紹由Canva Research開發的Brush視覺語言模型，先為Canva Pro訂戶提供支援的設計編輯；更廣泛開放仍在後續安排。

用戶可在Canva AI選擇Brush，要求跨頁改字或把設計改成另一種渠道格式。

Canva表示輸出元素仍可手動編輯；Brand Kit支援、參考附件及大量圖片版面改善仍在開發。

創意團隊可評估批量改版及多尺寸延伸，品牌一致性仍需用已批准素材逐頁覆核。

用一份已批准的多頁簡報試改標題及尺寸，檢查中文字、Logo、色彩與未要求修改的元素。

速度及成本數字屬Canva內部測試，本刊未重現；不把尚未推出的Brand Kit支援寫成現有功能。
article.detail_en:
Canva introduced Brush, a vision-language model from Canva Research, for supported design edits by Canva Pro subscribers. Wider availability is planned.

Users can select Brush in Canva AI for changes across pages or adaptation to another channel format.

Canva says elements remain editable; Brand Kit support, attachment references and image-heavy layout improvements are still in development.

Creative teams can assess bulk revisions and format adaptation, with page-level checks against approved brand assets.

Try a title and format change on an approved deck; inspect Chinese text, logos, colors and elements that should stay unchanged.

Speed and cost figures are internal tests, not reproduced here. Brand Kit support is not described as already available.
